Documentation.TagDescription: Staging bins used while inbound goods are being received. Demonstrates a nested namespace, which renders as a tag tree in the OpenAPI reference.

MethodDocumentation.GET: Read-only view of the bins reserved for inbound receiving. The endpoint lives at `endpoints/SQL/WMS/Inbound/StagingBins`, so its namespace is `WMS/Inbound` and it nests under `WMS` in the documentation.
